strings.terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} pou aprezan ouver an mars lo {method}.

• Si i pa ankor tennyen, tenny ou {device}.
• Si i konekte avek USB, dekonekte li avan.

strings.sp_gui_install_prompt_title: enstal atraver SP Flash Tool GUI
strings.sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI pou aprezan ouver avek ou firmware preloaded.

• Dan SP Flash Tool, selekte "Format All + Download" dan bwat desann.
• Klik lo bouton "Telesarz".
• Fer sir ki ou {device} i tennyen e dekonekte.
{hint}
• Konekte sa kab USB avek ou konpiter apre ki ou'n klik lo telesarze.

Klik OK pou lans SP Flash Tool e sorti dan Mizazour.

strings.support_story_1_headline: ler bann fabrikan i avanse, kominote i avanse.
strings.support_story_1_lead: protez ou laparey kont bann pyez hardware silansye e bann revizyon kase.
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis i regilyerman lans bann nouvo firmware pour bann zwer parey Y1 (ki target bann revizyon board kasyet parey 6.0, 7.0, e 8.0) ki silansman kas bann vye laparey. pli pir, zot sit web i donn zero lavertisman e zero akse avek bann firmware ki ti pe marse oparavan pou rekipere dan en leta brike. Mizazour ek proze Community Firmware i anmas bann morso: nou arsiv tou ROM stok leritaz, verifye ou revizyon hardware otomatikman, e gard ou zwer pe marse an sekirite.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: sov bann zwer kase: bann tyek sekirite i asire ki bann nouvo aktyalite pa zanmen brik bann vye hardware.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: ROM stok arsiv: Koleksyon konplet bann firmware orizinal lizin Innioasis in efase.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Bann zouti flashing konplet pour macOS, Linux, e Windows parey.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: lentelizans hardware: deteksyon otomatik lo bord pou ou toultan ganny sa bon package.
strings.support_story_2_headline: napa Google Drives kase. napa devinen. zis en firmware ki pe marse.
strings.support_story_2_lead: lenfrastriktir kominoter o-vites e verifye ki ou kapab depan lo la.
strings.support_story_2_body: swiv lozisyel ofisyel Innioasis i normalman vedir rod bann foronm pou bann lyen Google Drive ki'n ekspire, bann par dan cloud Baidu ki'n mor, e bann dosye zip misterye san okenn zouti ki flash. nou'n konstrir en rezo download serye e endepandan avek lentegrite SHA-256 verifye, notifikasyon azour, e lenstalasyon gide etap par etap. ou bann donasyon i gard direkteman bann download ek hosting ki fer sa posib 24 lo 24, 365 zour par an.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: CDN direk o-vites: bann telesarz vit, direk san okenn limit telesarz oubyen bann lyen mor.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Miz a zour Notifikasyon: Ganny alerte le moman ki nouvo laranzman kominoter oubyen bann solisyon i ganny large.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: bann lenstalasyon etap par etap gide: bann lenstriksyon vizyel kler i gid ou atraver sak bouton ki ou peze.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Kominote Miltileng: Konpletman lokalize an Angle, Sinwan, Alman, Espanyol, Franse ek Zaponnen.
strings.support_story_3_headline: deblok tou potansyel ou zwer Innioasis.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Anmenn Rockbox, bann sistenm loperasyon leze personnalize, e laliberte bann odyofil.
strings.support_story_3_body: lozisyel stokaz i zis grat sirfas sa ki ou hardware Y1 ou Y2 i kapab fer. nou kominote in anmenn Rockbox, bann sistenm loperasyon personnalize leze, zwe codec odyofil, e bann tenm personnalize a lavi. nou aste bann varyasyon hardware fizik dan nou pos pou teste, reverse engineer, e verifye sak lenstalasyon. siport Mizazour i finans direkteman sa bann younit tes e akseler devlopman firmware personnalize.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Lektir odyofil e bann tenm personnalize enstale dan detrwa segonn.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Firmware Kominoter: Amelyorasyon batri, UI pli prop, e sipor codec odyo modern.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Laboratwar Materyo Aktiv: Nou teste lo bann laparey fizik reel avan lans okenn konstriksyon.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% gratwit, lozisyel ki pran swen avek okenn piblisite oubyen swivi.
strings.support_story_4_headline: ed nou fer sa ki Innioasis pa fer.
strings.support_story_4_lead: prezervasyon firmware ki ganny alimante par kominote ki gard ou bann laparey an deor bann landfill.
strings.support_story_4_body: ler en lakonpannyen hardware i bouz lo zot prosen gadget, bann vye model i ganny abandonnen. Innioasis pa donn okenn sipor Linux, okenn changelog transparan, e okenn fason fasil pou rekipere ler en lenstalasyon i fel. Mizazour i egziste akoz bann itilizater pasyonnen pa devret bezwen zet en bon zwe lanmizik. 100% kontribisyon kominoter i al direkteman dan gard sa zouti ouver pou tou dimoun.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Sovtaz & Debrik: Rekiperasyon prouve i koule menm ler bann laparey i refize demare.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Sipor Linux First-Class: MediaTek i ganny siporte konpletman lo bann distribisyon Linux.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: bann rezis sanzman transparan: bann not detaye pour ou konnen egzakteman ki bann sanzman.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: 100% finanse par kominote: sak kafe i gard arsiv ouver e gratwit pou tou dimoun.

strings.err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Por USB COM pa ti kapab ganny ouver (fot 1013). relans ou konpiter pou larg sa por ki'n bloke. silvouple relans ou konpiter e esey ankor.
strings.err_sp_enable_dram: sa zouti pa ti kapab komans memwar sa zwer. servi sa package ki'n ganny konstrir pour sa model egzakt.
strings.err_sp_storage_read: sa zouti pa ti kapab lir stokaz sa zwer. tyek koneksyon; sa laparey i kapab annan en fot lo hardware.
strings.err_attempt_timeout: sa zouti ki ti pe flash pa ti montre okenn progre dan {seconds} segonn, alor sa lesey ti ganny arete.
strings.err_connection_failed_desc: pa'n kapab etablir en koneksyon stab avek sa zwer. fer sir ki sa laparey i tennyen (servi en pin pou pez bouton reset si i neseser), debrans USB, e rekonekte ler i ganny demande.
strings.err_flash_write_failed_desc: flashing in ganny enteronpe oubyen loperasyon ekrir in fel. Tyek ki kab USB i byen konekte e ki batri i annan ase sarz, apre esey ankor.
strings.err_mtk_output_stall_desc: sa zouti flash in montre menm laliny pour sa dernyen {seconds} segonn e i pa paret pe kontinyen ekrir sa firmware. flash i kapab in fel. si sa ti dernyen dan de lesey avek sak metod lo en sistenm ki kapab tonm ant zot, oubyen si zis MTKClient i disponib lo sa masin, relans sa konpiter e esey ankor.
strings.err_only_mtkclient_desc: zis MTKClient ki disponib pou sa lenstalasyon. flash i kapab in fel. silvouple relans sa konpiter e esey ankor.
strings.err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: sa konpiter i osi kapab enstale an servan SP Flash Tool. si ou kapab, sanz pour SP Flash Tool e esey ankor.
strings.prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: flash i kapab in fel. silvouple lir sa mesaz anler e relans konpiter avan esey ankor. si ou klik OK, sa app pou arete pou ou kapab relanse.
strings.err_missing_package_files_desc: sa package firmware i mank sa dosye scatter oubyen bann dosye zimaz neseser. silvouple re-telesarz sa package oubyen selekte en dosye firmware konplet.
strings.err_auth_file_unusable_title: dosye otantifikasyon pa kapab ganny servi
strings.err_auth_file_unusable_desc: sa dosye otantifikasyon ki ou'n swazir i manke, vid oubyen pa'n kapab ganny ekrir. swazir en dosye valid, oubyen efas li dan seting, apre flash ankor.
strings.err_tool_unavailable_desc: zouti flashing oubyen bann drayver sistenm neseser pa ti kapab ganny inisyalize. silvouple tyek permisyon sistenm, laranzman drayver, oubyen re-enstal laplikasyon.
strings.err_driver_missing_desc: sa lerer i kapab arive ler drayver MediaTek USB pa ganny enstale. Klik lo Download Drivers pou enstal MediaTek USB driver, relans ou konpiter, e esey ankor.
strings.err_cache_file_missing_desc: en dosye firmware ki'n ganny cache i manke. swazir selekte lozisyel pou rekonstrir bann dosye ki'n ganny tire oubyen telesarz arsiv firmware ankor. sa i en problenm dosye lokal, pa en problenm koneksyon USB.
strings.sel_cache_retry_tooltip: retourn lo selekte lozisyel pou rekonstrir oubyen telesarz sa package firmware.
strings.sel_cache_retry_select_release: selekte en versyon firmware pou telesarze ankor.
strings.err_generic_flash_failed_desc: En fot san ekspekte in arive pandan lenstalasyon ({detail}). tenny sa zwer konpletman, rekonekte ler i ganny demande, e esey ankor.
strings.flash_attempt_timeout: pe esper sa zwer... {seconds} i reste
strings.flash_method_confirm: metod lenstalasyon in sanze pour vin {method}. konfirmen ki sa zwer in ganny debranse e tennyen, apre klik lo prosen.
strings.flash_failover_note: {method} pa'n konmans lenstalasyon. apre ki sa zwer in ganny tennyen e debranse, {other} pou ganny servi dan son plas.
strings.themepack_card_desc: Enkli bann zoli tenm kominoter, bann backdrop o rezolisyon, e bann font ki'n ganny fabrike spesifikman pour bann prezantasyon 360p.
strings.themepack_installed_success: 360p Theme Pack in ganny enstale avek sikse!
strings.themepack_step1_title: Letap 1: Konekte dan Mod Stokaz USB
strings.themepack_step1_desc:
1. alim ou zwer par tenir bouton pouvwar.
2. ler Rockbox i demare, konekte sa kab USB dan ou konpiter.
3. Si i ganny demande lo lekran zwer, konfirm mod stokaz USB pou ki sa laparey i aparet koman en drive.
strings.themepack_step2_title: letap 2: selekte nenport dosye lo sa zwer
strings.themepack_step2_desc: Akoz bann sistenm loperasyon (tel ki macOS) i kasyet bann dotfile (parey .rockbox) par defo, ou kapab selekte NENPORT ki dosye oubyen rasin drive lo ou zwer. nou pou otomatikman trouv ou kree repertwar .rockbox pou ou.
strings.themepack_complete: Pack tenm in ganny enstale avek sikse! ou kapab aprezan dekonekte ou zwer e selekte en tenm dan Rockbox (Settings > Theme Settings).
strings.themepack_err_not_found: pa'n kapab lokaliz ou inisyal en repertwar .rockbox lo sa drive selekte. silvouple asire ki ou'n selekte en dosye lo ou zwer.
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: letap 1: relans sa zwer e rekonekte
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Dekonekte kab USB.
2. Re-alim sa zwer e les li demar dan Rockbox.
3. Enn fwa ki Rockbox pe marse, rekonekte kab USB, apre pez Kontinyen.
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Letap 2: Pe rod sa zwer lo ADB...
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: sa app pe vey en koneksyon ADB (ziska 30 segonn). si en laparey i ganny trouve, bann tenm i ganny transfer e sa zwer i relanse otomatikman. sinon, sot devan lo mod stokaz USB.
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: pe esper en laparey ADB... (ziska 30 segonn)
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_found: laparey in ganny trouve ({serial}); pe transfer bann tenm...
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: napa okenn laparey ADB ki'n ganny detekte dan 30 segonn; kontinyen avek Mod Stokaz USB.
strings.rockbox_wizard_no_adb: napa okenn biner ADB ki disponib pou sa app; kontinyen avek Mod Stokaz USB.
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: pe pous bann tenm ek font lo ADB...
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: transfer ADB in fel; pe retourn dan Mod Stokaz USB
strings.rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Met an mars Mod Stokaz USB lo sa zwer pou li aparet koman en drive.
2. Swazir NENPORT ki dosye lo sa zwer anba (.rockbox, Lanmizik, Tenm, oubyen rasin drive, en dosye .rockbox kasyet i ganny lokalize otomatikman).
3. Sa app i zwenn bann tenm ek font 360p, e ekrir bann dosye menm non.
strings.rockbox_wizard_done_title: tenm 360p ek font in ganny enstale!
strings.rockbox_wizard_done_desc: ou kapab aprezan dekonekte sa zwer e swazir en tenm dan Rockbox (Settings > Theme Settings).
strings.rockbox_stage_installing: pe enstal bann tenm ek font Rockbox...
strings.rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: plis ki en zwer i konekte. dekonekte bann lezot e kit zis sa enn ki pe ganny enstale.
strings.rockbox_stage_pushing: zwer in ganny detekte. pe plas bann tenm ek font kominoter...
strings.rockbox_stage_pushing_files_fmt: pe plas bann dosye tenm ({curr} of {total})...
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: tenir bouton santral pou alim ou Y1, rekonekte USB, e selekte Mod Stokaz USB.
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: tenir bouton pouvwar pou alim ou zwer, rekonekte USB, e selekte Mod Stokaz USB.
strings.rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: silvouple dekonekte e alim ou {model}, apre pez Next
strings.rockbox_step1_power_on_button: dekonekte USB, tenir {button} pou alim ou {model}, apre pez Next.
strings.rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: silvouple met mod stokaz USB lo ou laparey e klik lo prosen
strings.rockbox_step_select_player_folder: silvouple selekte sa zwer limenm ou enn bann dosye lo la
strings.rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: dekonekte USB e alim ou Y1, apre pez Next.
strings.rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: dekonekte USB e alim ou {model}, apre pez Next.
strings.rockbox_ask_running_fmt: eski Rockbox pe marse lo ou {model}?
strings.rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Selekte 'Mod Stokaz USB' lo ou zwer.
2. Klik 'Browse Folder...' pou selekte ou zwer e enstal bann tenm.
strings.rockbox_site_themes_note: sa konstriksyon Rockbox i servi bann tenm 240×320, ki pa ganny met ansanm. ganny bann tenm gratwit pour ou zwer lo sit tenm Rockbox:
strings.rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: si ou {model} pa demare, dekonekte USB, tenir bouton alimantasyon pou 10 segonn pou reset, e alimen. Oubyen restor lozisyel orizinal.
strings.err_storage_full_desc: ou konpiter in fini avek lespas stokaz. silvouple liber lespas lo ou disk e esey ankor.
strings.err_usb_lost_subtitle: eski ou ti a kontan esey ankor?
strings.legacy_cleanup_desc: en vye versyon Updater i ankor lo sa konpiter e i pran lespas lo disk. dezenstal li i liber sa lespas.
strings.legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: retir bann vye laplikasyon Innioasis Updater e bann dosye sipor
strings.legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: gard bann zouti platform Android (ADB / Fastboot) enstale
strings.legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: si ou pa servi ADB ou Fastboot an deor Mizazour, demarke pou dezenstal e reklanm stokaz adisyonnel.
strings.legacy_cleanup_done_msg: in reisi netway lenstalasyon leritaz e reklanm lespas lo disk.
strings.donate_completion_subtitle_the_software: sa lozisyel in ganny enstale lo ou {model}.
strings.legacy_cleanup_card_desc: en vye versyon Updater i ankor lo sa konpiter. dezenstal li i liber lespas lo disk.
strings.legacy_cleanup_none_found: napa vye versyon ki'n ganny trouve.
strings.legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: sa i retir sa vye app ek son bann dosye sipor. firmware ki'n ganny telesarze i ganny garde.
strings.legacy_cleanup_tools_body: retir bann zouti platform Android (ADB / Fastboot) osi? swazir garde si ou servi ADB.
strings.legacy_cleanup_done_inline: in ganny retire, apepre {size} in ganny libere.
strings.log_btn_goto_file_tip: revel dosye log dan Finder / Explorer
strings.log_btn_save_file_tip: eksport sa dosye rezis ki'n ganny demontre lo disk
strings.log_btn_copy_tip: Kopye rezis ki'n ganny demontre lo clipboard
strings.update_start_failed_fmt: pa'n kapab komans met a zour: {error}
strings.legacy_cleanup_errors_fmt:
serten itenm pa'n kapab ganny retire:

{errors}
strings.settings_arm64_driver_note: sipor Windows ARM64 pa ankor ganny teste. lo bann portab Snapdragon ek RTX Spark, Zadig i kapab ganny servi avek Driver Signature Enforcement dezaktive pou enstal WinUSB ou libusb pou laparey MT6227 Preloader dan Device Manager. vwar gid drayver ARM64 pou bann letap.
strings.sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: sa versyon i kontenir plis ki en dosye scatter, alor Updater pa kapab dir ki laranzman ou zwer i bezwen. Devloper {software} ti pou bezwen met azour zot bann laranzman firmware pou enkli zis en sel dosye scatter.
strings.settings_run_in_background_desc: gard sa app dan bar meni oubyen plato sistenm apre ki lafnet i fermen, pou ou ankor ganny notifikasyon azour firmware app ek zwer. tennyen: ferm lafnet i kit sa app.
strings.donate_goal_week_status_fmt: Ou'n ed nou anmas ${raised} nou ${target} kou sa semenn
strings.donate_goal_day_status_fmt: Ou'n ed nou anmas ${raised} dan nou ${target} kou ozordi
strings.donate_support_appeal_servers: bann server, stokaz ek domenn i ganny peye avek ou pos. en kafe i gard bann download online pou prosen propriyeter.
strings.donate_support_appeal_evenings: sak lansman isi i ganny konstrir dan bann sware ek wikenn. En pti don i aste plis sa letan.
strings.donate_support_appeal_independent: napa piblisite, napa swivi e napa nivo peye. Lendepandans i ganny finanse par dimoun sa ti ede.
strings.donate_support_appeal_testbench: bann donasyon i aste bann zwer teste e bann kab ki ganny servi pou tyek sak laranzman avan ki personn i flash li.
strings.donate_support_appeal_bandwidth: arsiv firmware i bouz terabytes tou le mwan. bann donasyon i pey pou bandwidth ki delivre li.
strings.donate_support_appeal_monthly_costs: kou fonksyonnman i ariv apepre $200 par mwan. nenport kwa ki ou kapab azoute i ferm sa gap.
strings.donate_support_appeal_small_change: detrwa liv i al bokou isi: i kouver bandwidth pou plizyer santenn lenstalasyon.
strings.donate_support_appeal_long_nights: bann bug i ganny aranze akoz en dimoun in reste avek ou model lo ban. en donasyon i gard sa an mars.
strings.donate_support_appeal_behind_the_scenes: napa lakonpannyen par deryer sa, zis en devloper, en workbench ek en paz donasyon. tou keksoz i al dan kou fonksyonnman.
strings.donate_support_appeal_next_feature: bann zouti, bann gid ek arsiv i tou gratwit. en konsey i finans sa prosen karakteristik.
strings.donate_support_appeal_kindness: si sa in marse pour ou, pas sa labonte. i gard sa proze gratwit pou nenport ki ki vini apre.
strings.donate_support_appeal_rescue: serten bann zwer ki sa i siporte ti ganny efase konman kase. en donasyon i gard servis sovtaz an mars.
strings.donate_support_appeal_no_subscription: napa abonnman, napa dele, zis en paz parey sa enn. donn selman si in ede.
strings.donate_support_appeal_one_person: en dimoun i reponn bann size, ekrir bann gid e pey bann bill. bann donasyon i fer sa vin soutenab.
strings.donate_support_appeal_archive_forever: Firmware i disparet ler bann host i fermen. bann donasyon i gard bann kopi ki'n sov ou zwer online.
strings.donate_support_appeal_coffee_math: en kafe i kouver apepre bandwidth en download. i gard sa prosen solisyon dan son lanmen.
strings.donate_family_appeal_expected: Ryan ek son partner pe ekspekte en pti baba. bann donasyon anver kou fonksyonnman proze e nou nouvo fanmir i ganny apresye masivman.
strings.donate_family_appeal_new_arrival: I annan en nouvo larive lo semen dan lakaz Ryan. sak donasyon anver bann server ek nou fanmir ki pe grandi i vedir bokou.
strings.donate_family_appeal_nursery: Ryan ek son partner pe prepar zot zanfan. si sa zouti in itil, en donasyon pou kou fonksyonnman e nou fanmir ki pe grandi ti pou ed plis ki ou konnen.
